title: Canonical attendance record (ground truth)
description: One normalized attendance record for one employee on one date, as the ingestion pipeline is expected to produce it from a source evidence file. Used for the ground-truth JSONL files in the synthetic sample-data package.

record_key.description: First 16 hex characters of sha256('<tenant_id>|<product_id>|<module>|<employee_id>|<attendance_date>'). Independent of the source file, so a corrected re-upload updates the same record.

tenant_id.description: Tenant (top level of the isolation hierarchy tenant -> department -> employee).

product_id.description: Product the record belongs to, e.g. 'hrms'.

entity_id.description: Department code within the tenant, e.g. 'ENG'.

employee_id.description: Employee identifier, unique only within a tenant (IDs deliberately overlap across tenants).

status.description: Canonical status after mapping raw_status through the tenant's status_codes table.

raw_status.description: The status text exactly as it appears in the source file (e.g. 'Present', 'Work From Home', 'HD', 'WO').

check_in.description: Local check-in time, 24-hour HH:MM, or null when the source has no time.

check_out.description: Local check-out time, 24-hour HH:MM, or null when the source has no time.

total_hours.description: check_out - check_in in hours, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null when there are no times.

remarks.description: Free-text remark from the source, or null.

remarks_sensitivity.description: null when there is no remark; 'confidential' for ordinary remarks (same level as the record); 'restricted' for remarks with medical details or personal contact data (visible only with restricted clearance).

pii_types.description: Kinds of sensitive personal data found in the remark.

classification.description: Classification level of the record. Levels in order: public < internal < confidential < restricted.

source_file.description: File name of the source evidence file (no directory).

source_locator.description: Machine-readable position of the record in the source file.

source_page_or_row.description: Human-readable form of source_locator, used in citations.

expected_review_status.description: 'needs_review' when the extraction is expected to fall below the tenant's OCR review threshold, otherwise 'auto_accepted'.

time_hhmm_or_null.description: 24-hour HH:MM. A pattern is used instead of format 'time' because JSON Schema's 'time' format requires seconds and a UTC offset.

row_locator.description: CSV: physical line number, header line = 1.

cell_locator.description: XLSX: worksheet name, A1-style cell reference and its row number.

table_row_locator.description: DOCX: 1-based table index counted across the document, 1-based data row excluding the header row.

page_row_locator.description: PDF (text or scanned): 1-based page, 1-based data row on that page excluding the header row.

allOf.description: Statuses without attendance times never carry times or hours.
Times come in pairs, and total_hours is present exactly when times are.
Sensitivity and PII types only apply when there is a remark.
A restricted remark names at least one PII type; other remarks name none.
Only OCR extractions are expected to need review.
